g.title: ESP32
g.text: ESP32 devboard (ESP-WROOM-32, USB-C), socketed on the carrier
Only the pins used on this sheet are shown. USB = micro-ROS link (UART0, 921600). Unused: GPIO36 battery ADC, GPIO39 rain. GPIO2 = status LED.

g.title: J_GNSS
g.text: 20 pins, 4 used. Must also take another RTK board later.

g.title: C94
g.text: 3.3 V UART, 19200. Pin 20 RADIO_OFF left open. J8 is a socket: the ribbon's IDC plug goes in through a 2x10 pin header with long pins on both sides (to buy). Pitch and own board version not checked.

g.title: INA226
g.text: INA226 module, on the carrier, 2 mOhm shunt

g.title: TOF_FL
g.text: 9 bare holes 2.54 mm + loose pin header. For I2C: NCS and SPI_I2C_N to GND (ST); plug not chosen

g.title: TOF_FR
g.text: 9 bare holes 2.54 mm + loose pin header. For I2C: NCS and SPI_I2C_N to GND (ST); plug not chosen

g.title: HUB
g.text: USB-C OTG adapter, 2-in-1 (USB-A data + USB-C charge port)

g.title: BUCK
g.text: 24 V to 5 V 10 A buck, potted
